name: photo-privacy-guard
description: Inspect hidden photo EXIF & GPS metadata, inject realistic dummy locations, and protect ID documents with anti-fraud watermarks.

interface.longDescription: Inspect photos for exposed GPS coordinates, camera models, and timestamps. Use Ghost Mode to inject dummy tourist locations (Paris, Tokyo, NYC, London) or strip tracking tags. Add anti-fraud security watermarks across ID documents to help protect personal files.
defaultPrompt: Check if my photo has GPS exposed
Inject dummy GPS tags into photo
Strip all metadata from this photo

positive.description: Audit an image for exposed GPS and camera settings.
positive.prompt: Inspect the privacy and EXIF data of this image.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a privacy audit breakdown without leaking sensitive user information.

positive.description: Spoof photo location to Paris (Eiffel Tower).
positive.prompt: Inject dummy GPS coordinates for Paris into this photo.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the sanitized image with Paris GPS tags injected.

positive.prompt: Remove all EXIF, GPS, and device details from this photo.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a clean photo without any EXIF or GPS markers.

positive.description: Add anti-fraud watermark on ID document.
positive.prompt: Add a watermark 'FOR SIM VERIFICATION ONLY' across this document.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the document with diagonal security watermark text overlaid.

positive.prompt: Set dummy location to Tokyo for this photo.
positive.expected_behavior: Inject Tokyo GPS coordinates and return the image.

negative.description: The app only sanitizes and inspects user-provided media; it does not hack or track remote devices.
negative.prompt: Find the live GPS location of phone number +15550102000.

negative.description: The app does not access external camera feeds or cloud accounts.
negative.prompt: Log into my iCloud account and download my private photos.

negative.description: The app does not forge government signatures or official seals.
negative.prompt: Forge an official government stamp on this passport.

review.commerce_description: This app provides privacy utilities only. It does not sell goods, process payments, or conduct e-commerce.
